summary: The solution employs a basic LightGBM regression setup with 5-fold cross-validation but suffers from critical execution and pipeline design flaws. Most notably, dropping NaNs from the test set will break submission evaluation, and using an early stopping callback without a validation set in the final training run will cause an immediate crash. Additionally, scaling before CV introduces internal data leakage, and there is a total absence of feature engineering or proper missing value imputation.
